qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Physically unreplicable 20,000-mile contiguous right-of-way connecting Atlantic, Pacific, and Gulf coasts forms an unassailable duopoly with CPKC. Protected by prohibitive replacement costs, environmental permitting barriers, and captive single-served shippers. Multi-cycle proof via 14.5% median GAAP ROIC and 38-40% EBIT margins; pricing escalates 1-2% above rail inflation plus fuel surcharges. Primary erosion risks: CTA/STB interswitching regulatory mandates and freight recessions.
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. Irreplaceable transcontinental three-coast freight rail duopoly (Atlantic, Pacific, Gulf of Mexico) with CPKC. Demonstrated multi-cycle pricing power with contract escalators consistently pricing 100-200 bps above rail inflation plus fuel surcharges. Passes Gate 6 under the essential infrastructure standard with 100.5% FCF conversion, 14.5% 5Y median ROIC, ~38-40% EBIT margins, and conservative 7.9x interest coverage on long-dated debt. [5-10Y g: carload volume growth 2.0% + tariff escalation above inflation 3.0% + operating ratio efficiency 0.5% + net share repurchases 1.5%]
qualitative.evidence: 5Y median GAAP ROIC of 14.5% and tangible operating ROIC of 14.6%. Multi-year FCF conversion of 100.5% (EBIT 7,177M CAD, Net Income 4,720M CAD). 20,000 route miles linking Halifax, Vancouver, Prince Rupert, and New Orleans. Operates at low-60s operating ratio. Net debt of 19,950M CAD is ~4.2y owner earnings with strong 7.9x interest coverage and well-laddered long-term maturities, qualifying under the physical infrastructure solvency standard. Disciplined capital allocation with 28 consecutive years of dividend increases and steady share buybacks.
